comparison_based_rationale: The frozen item presents a plausible Massachusetts home-delivery workflow in which one required component of the statutory off-site counseling pathway has already been supplied and the examinee must identify the remaining operational step before shipment. Full-bank comparison found no other item testing the same toll-free-service-plus-each-container-label decision path. MA-Q-0086 is closest legally because it also applies §21A counseling mechanics, but its task is refusal documentation at pickup. MA-Q-0215 is closest operationally because it involves mailing a prescription, but its task is temperature/stability protection. MA-Q-0092 is a counseling-adjacent federal/state interaction item. The keyed answer is not uniquely conspicuous by length or form; the alternatives map to credible implementation errors involving outer packaging, receipts, post-delivery communication, or substitution of a local number. Although the controlling statutory phrase is specific, the item does not merely ask the examinee to recite it in isolation: the stem requires recognizing that toll-free access alone is incomplete in the stated delivery workflow and selecting the legally sufficient placement among competing operational alternatives. The answer is therefore singular, practice-plausible, and materially distinct from the frozen bank.
